mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS accountTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = 'USER' ) THEN u.id END) AS userTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.created_at >= CURDATE() AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = 'USER' ) THEN u.id END) AS todayNewUsers FROM user u WHERE u.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS productTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ON_SALE' AND audit_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS productOnSale, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingReviewProducts FROM product WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'PENDING_SHIPMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingShipmentOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.created_at >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayNewOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('PENDING_SHIPMENT', 'PENDING_RECEIPT', 'COMPLETED') AND p.id IS NOT NULL THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalSalesAmount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payment_record p ON p.order_id = o.id AND p.status = 'SUCCESS'

SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status, o.created_at AS createdAt, o.receiver_name AS buyerName, CASE WHEN o.receiver_phone IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(o.receiver_phone) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(o.receiver_phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(o.receiver_phone, 4)) ELSE o.receiver_phone END AS buyerPhoneMasked, first_item.product_name AS firstProductName, item_summary.item_count AS itemCount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, MIN(id) AS first_item_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_item GROUP BY order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN order_item first_item ON first_item.id = item_summary.first_item_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.main_image AS mainImage, p.price, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.audit_status AS auditStatus, COALESCE(mp.store_name, u.nickname, u.username, '') AS merchantName FROM product p LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = p.merchant_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN merchant_profile mp ON mp.user_id = p.merchant_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.audit_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
